crossRefs.note: Therefore a man will leave his father and his mother, and will join with his wife, and they will be one flesh.
and said, ‘For this cause a man shall leave his father and mother, and shall be joined to his wife; and the two shall…

“For this cause a man will leave his father and mother, and will be joined to his wife. The two will become one flesh.”
